reasons: No gene, no name (NO NAME), no annotation beyond SBO; added with the iYli21 R2130-R2200 block and un-annotated in the raw iyli21.xml.

Its equation (6.5 O2 + dehydrodolichol-PP = dolichyl-PP + 5 CO2 + 3 H2O) matches no enzyme of the yeast dolichol route: polyprenyl-PP is dephosphorylated and reduced to dolichol, which Sec59 phosphorylates (TASK.md B7-B12).
Kept as a closed reaction rather than deleted: deletion needs evidence that it does not exist, and closing records the decision without losing the inherited entry.

With a Dol-P drain and R2178 open, R2178 is obligatory (FVA min = max) and the CWH8 ortholog becomes essential while the SEC59 ortholog stays dispensable, the reverse of S. cerevisiae genetics (TASK.md section 4, Option A).

notes.dolichol_route_r2178_reason: Closed (not deleted): gene-less, un-annotated iYli21 placeholder whose O2-consuming, CO2-releasing equation matches no enzyme of the dolichol route; replaced by R_DOLSYN (dehydrodolichol-PP to dolichol, then Sec59 R287 to Dol-P).

kept_reaction.role: dolichol kinase (SEC59 ortholog YALI1E22718g, KEGG K00902); the only consumer of dolichol m499 and the step that the new reaction feeds

new_reaction.reaction_name: dehydrodolichyl diphosphate to dolichol (lumped dephosphorylation, polyprenol oxidation, polyprenal and dolichal reduction)

component_steps.enzyme: not characterised in the sources read (TASK.md B12)

component_steps.step: polyprenol + NAD = polyprenal + NADH (model convention; NAD+ + H+ release in textbook notation)
component_steps.enzyme: S. cerevisiae Tda5 (Hanaoka et al. 2026); Y. lipolytica ortholog not identified
S. cerevisiae Dfg10, EC 1.3.1.94, KEGG R13444; Y. lipolytica candidate ortholog YALI1E09357g (YALI0E07788g, K12345), not in the model
S. cerevisiae Env9 (Hanaoka et al. 2026); Y. lipolytica ortholog not identified

new_reaction.why_gene_less: Three enzymes, one of them uncharacterised and two without an identified Y. lipolytica ortholog; a single-gene GPR on the lumped step would not meet AGENTS.md section 5, and dfg10 deletion is viable in S. cerevisiae (alternative route, Cantagrel 2010).
new_reaction.balance_note: Cannot be balance-checked as built: dehydrodolichol-PP m2019 has no formula and dolichol m499 carries a farnesol formula C15H28O. With a Dol-16 formula set filled in memory (m2019 C80H132O7P2, m499 C80H132O) C, H, N, O and P balance and the charge is -2, the model's NADP charge convention (NADP C21H29 charge 0, -1 per NADPH; the same pattern as R16 and R1393). The dolichol-family formula set is a separate chemistry task.

notes.dolichol_route_evidence: S. cerevisiae: polyprenol is reduced to dolichol through Tda5 (NAD+), Dfg10 and Env9 (NADPH) (Hanaoka et al. 2026, PMID 42201967); SRD5A3/Dfg10 needed for dolichol (PMID 20637498); Sec59 phosphorylates dolichol. Y. lipolytica: DFG10 candidate ortholog YALI1E09357g by KEGG orthology only.
notes.dolichol_route_evidence_tier: S. cerevisiae experiment plus Y. lipolytica orthology; no Y. lipolytica dolichol data
notes.dolichol_route_limits: Lumped and gene-less; not mass-balanced (m2019 has no formula, m499 has a farnesol formula); the polyprenyl-PP phosphatase is uncharacterised; Tda5 and Env9 orthologs not identified; NUS1 ortholog YALI1F26726g not in the model.

biomass_term.derivation: Order-of-magnitude value. S. cerevisiae dolichol 32 (late log) to 48 (early stationary) ug/g, basis not stated and probably wet weight (Gryz et al. 2019, citing Surmacz and Swiezewska 2011, unread); Dol-16 C80H132O 1109.9 g/mol; with dry matter 20-25 % of wet weight this is 1.2e-4 to 2.2e-4 mmol/gDW, and 2.9e-5 to 4.3e-5 if the figure were dry weight. The term stands for the dolichol-derived carrier pool, since free dolichol has no consumer other than R287. Stage 1: growth differs by less than 1e-4 relative across 4e-5 to 1.6e-4 and no targeted knockout changes with the value.
biomass_term.evidence_tier: literature value for S. cerevisiae, unit basis assumed; not a Y. lipolytica measurement

evidence.claim: EC 1.3.1.94 polyprenal reductase, KEGG R13444 (dolichal + NADP+ = polyprenal + NADPH + H+); lists sce YIL049W and yli 2912457.
Srt1 products are longer, mainly on lipid particles, and not sufficiently converted to dolichol and Dol-P.
evidence.scope: Abstract read; S. cerevisiae; why UM6 is left as it is.

evidence.claim: Rer2 is also on lipid droplets; long Srt1 polyprenols are not efficiently converted to dolichol.
rer2 deletion grows very slowly with about 2.7 % of wild-type cis-prenyltransferase activity; rer2 srt1 double disruption is lethal.
sec59 deletion is inviable in S. cerevisiae.
SRD5A3 / Dfg10 are required to reduce polyprenol to dolichol; depleted cells still contain some dolichol.
In yeast, Tda5 oxidises polyprenol to polyprenal, Dfg10 reduces polyprenal to dolichal and Env9 reduces dolichal to dolichol (NADPH).
evidence.scope: Abstract read; S. cerevisiae; Y. lipolytica TDA5 / ENV9 orthologs not identified.

evidence.claim: S. cerevisiae dolichol 32 ug/g (late log) and 48 ug/g (early stationary), citing Surmacz and Swiezewska 2011 (unread).
